name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

priority.description: The value associated with this prioritized instance.

hidden.description: Whether prioritized value should be omitted from the ordering

label.description: A label for the category. This may be a translation key or a literal category string.

associatedPath.description: A location prefix to drop file chunks. Only used by FileUpload data connector.

storageKind.description: The name of the storage location for the connector.

provider.description:
The vendor/provider for the connector. This is used for attribution. If not defined, the connector is assumed to
be "Open Source" and will be marked as such in the UI. This may be a translation key or a literal provider string.

imagePath.description:
A path to the asset to render as the icon for the connector. If not defined, no icon will be rendered.
The path should resemble `"assets/images/{data connector name}.svg"` and the image should be placed in
`{packageName}/ui/content/assets/images/`.

This takes precedence over {@link iconName}.

iconName.description:
Alternative to {@link imagePath} if there is no image. This can render a FontAwesome icon. {@link imagePath} takes
precedence if both are defined.

category.description: The category associated with the connector. If the category is disabled, the connector will be hidden in the UI.

credentialConfig.description: The configuration for the connector's credentials.

beforeCredentialSetContext.description: The configuration of a the args for {@link#beforeCredentialSetAction}

fieldOverrides.description: The field properties for the connector. This is used as properties overrides to SQLEngine config

existingFieldsProperties.description:
Field properties for existing connectors which would be migrated to SQLEngine configs
NOTE: To be deprecated from version 8.11

sourceSystemType.description: The {@link SourceSystem} subtype for the data connector

beforeCredentialSetAction.description: The API to optionally call before setting credentials on this data connector

errorMappings.description: List of errors typically returned by this data connector and their corresponding error messages

title: A representation of a Data Connector for use in the UI.
name: SelfServiceDI.Ui.DataConnector
